select id,emp_no empNo,name,photo photo,is_dispose isDispose,create_time createTime
from TO_C6_EPHOTO
AND name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.name}),'%')
AND emp_no LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.empNo}),'%')
AND create_time between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
order by create_time desc
